item.title: App: name the legacy counterpart of each ported view (H.2, comments only)
item.body:
## Issue
Refs #368 (directive H.2; the rule itself lands in the H.1–H.3 docs PR)
Claim: cloud/ui-convergence

## What and why
**Problem.** The app code merged under `App/` rarely says which legacy file it ports, so ezzz cannot find his structure in it and a parity check has to start from scratch.

**Change.** 34 files: each view or view model that ports the legacy Swift layer gets one comment above its main type:
`// Port of HFRswift/Swift/<File>.swift (<Symbol>) @ 2440d79. Differences: … (GAP-NNN; UXD)`.
- The differences name the GAP row of `docs/migration/GAP-LEGACY-VS-SWIFT.md`; `UXD` marks a difference that waits on an arbitration (`docs/migration/UX-DECISIONS-PENDING.md`, docs PR).
- `RootNavigationView` cited a `master` line (`MainWindow.swift:1353-1355`); it now cites `1132-1134` @ `2440d79`.
- Files with no legacy counterpart (image policy C, loaders, error types, engine wiring) are left alone.

Why this wide: every ported view and view model merged so far, in one pass, as the directive asks. No code line changes.

## How it was verified
- `git diff` holds only added or edited `//` and `///` lines.
- SwiftLint 0.65.1 on `App`: no warning.
- Every cited file and symbol was read at `2440d79` while writing the comments (`git show 2440d79:<path>`). The adversarial review (Sonnet) re-checks a sample of 20 plus every one it doubts.

## Checklist (AGENTS.md §9)
- [x] Module boundaries respected (comments only)
- [x] Tests: not applicable (no behaviour change)
- [x] No secrets
- [x] Docs: the rule and the template are in the H docs PR
- [ ] Author model: Opus / Reviewer model: Sonnet
- [x] No legacy behaviour changed

### Adversarial review (Sonnet; author Opus)

**Round 1 on `8b50e49`: APPROVE, 3 minor findings, all fixed in `eef6a01`.**
1. `ReaderReplyFlow.swift`: the "Répondre" literal is in `AnswerView.swift:115` (default title), not in `MessagesView`. The comment now cites both.
2. `RootTab.swift`: `init(startup:)` and the start-screen setting come from `master` (GAP-002). The comment now says so.
3. `OrientationPolicy.swift`: "applied live" was weak, because legacy also refreshes live. The comment now names the real differences: the pure rule, and the composer's portrait lock (`lockForAnswerViewIfNeeded`), which is not ported yet.

**Round 2 on `eef6a01`: APPROVE.**

Checks:
- Comments only: every changed line is `//` or `///`, and none is over 140 characters.
- Every cited file and symbol exists at `2440d79`. The reviewer checked all of them, more than the sample of 20.
- The GAP ids exist and match their topics.

Merge: this PR is not docs-only, so it is left to `cloud/orch`, per the directive. It waits on green CI and the CodeRabbit round.
